Alicia — thanks for the note. Attached is a focused MAP v2 tailored to the POC: short checklist + owners + a proposed two-week close timeline for environment activation. Highlights below and inline owners/times are in the PDF:

- Org setup (owner: Monica Patel) — create tenant, seed service account, and provide onboarding doc: 1 business day after signed MAP.
- API keys (owner: Jordan Blake) — we issue an ephemeral API key for the evaluation (rotates every 24h). Long-lived service keys are available if you prefer; we recommend ephemeral for trials. Expected delivery: key escrow + test key within 24 hours of tenant creation.
- IP allowlist (owner: RealHealth IT / coordinated with Neha) — provide public egress ranges for your firewall; we will provide the Redwood public egress CIDR list and a short-lived tunnel if you need immediate access. Target: add on Day 2 of the MAP.
- VPC peering (owner: Neha Kapoor) — supported in Dedicated/private mode; for the evaluation we can do peering prep (route table exchange, allowed ports) but full peering typically takes 3–5 business days with cloud ops. If you need an immediate private path, we can stand up a temporary VPN as a workaround (1–2 days).

Next asks from you:
- Confirm firewall contact (name + email) for RealHealth IT so we can schedule the peering window.
- Confirm whether you want ephemeral keys only (recommended) or an initial long-lived service key.

I've attached: RealHealth_MAP_v2.pdf (action card + timeline) and a short network diagram draft. Jordan, Neha — adding you both to pick up the keys and peering work.

Regards,
